verdict.rationale: Mailgun provides background automation building blocks — webhooks that 'automate responses without API polling' (mailgun-docs-8), inbound routing rules (mailgun-docs-6, mailgun-docs-33), and no-code integrations via n8n, GitHub Actions, and Supabase Edge Functions that trigger sends from events (mailgun-docs-37, mailgun-docs-38, mailgun-docs-39) — which together let a user wire up autonomous, event-driven email automations. However, Mailgun itself has no native scheduler/cron or agent-orchestration layer; autonomy depends on external glue (n8n, webhooks, custom code) rather than a built-in 'set and forget' automation engine. Missing for 10: native scheduled/recurring automation within Mailgun, first-party evidence of fully autonomous multi-step workflows, and independent corroboration that these integrations reliably run unattended in production.
